A '''chieftain's hut''' stood in the [[Talz village/Legends|Talz village]] on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was home to the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] chieftain [[Thi-Sen/Legends|Thi-Sen]]. It was where [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], later accompanied by [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and Pantoran [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi/Legends|Riyo Chuchi]], met with Thi-Sen just prior to the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle of Orto Plutonia]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].
